what: Turns the FM-1 into a generative drum machine. Press REC for a new groove: four parts on their own lengths (polymeters), thirty-eight synthesised drum engines, four personalities (BRAINDANCE, FLOORS, CLOUDS, IMPLODE), step components that EVOLVE brings in, punch-in effects on the white keys and randomisers on the black keys, a kit bus with reverb, delay, pan and a tape compressor. Plays under After Images: follows its clock and hears its notes.
author: TheGrizard
